description: Structured rows from the Consumer Recreation Demand API (https://api.fronresearch.com/v1): markets, venues, bookable slots and a utilization and a revenue estimate per venue, market or day. Without a key every query reads one free sample day for every venue, whatever dates are asked (the response's tier, free_day and range say what was read); a caller that connects to https://fronresearch.com/api/agent with "Authorization: Bearer <key>" reads the history its plan covers (a site's own /api/agent does not forward keys). Start with endpoint index (the sample day and endpoints), then markets or venues to get ids, then demand. Fields, filters and how to get a key: https://fronresearch.com/data/history/

endpoint.description: index: the sample day, tier and endpoints. markets, venues: lists (filters: market, brand, venue_type, activity). venue: one venue with its products and resources (needs venue_id). demand: the data, as one tree. Each venue with a utilization and a revenue estimate (low, expected, high, grade) for the range and for each of its days (params from, to (at most 92 days) and optional filters market, brand, venue_type, activity, venue). slots=true adds each day's slots. group_by = market, brand, venue_type or venue returns totals instead of the tree. observations=changes or all (each slot's remaining count and price over time) and booking_curve=true (needs venue) need an Investor key.

params.description: Query parameters as the Consumer Recreation Demand API names them, e.g. {"group_by": "market", "from": "2026-11-05", "to": "2026-11-05"}. limit (1-1000) and cursor (from next_cursor) page through lists.

venue_id.description: For endpoint venue: a venue_id from venues.
